title: The affine derived unit induces isomorphisms on cohomology
statement: In the setting of the affine derived unit theorem, for every derived A-module M and every integer n, the map on degree-n homology induced by adj.unit.app M is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Use the natural cohomology comparisons for derived global sections and for the derived associated-sheaf functor. Naturality of the right-derived-functor unit identifies the induced map with the ordinary affine module unit followed by the map of a K-injective quasi-isomorphism; the ordinary unit is invertible by full faithfulness of tilde and the resolution map is invertible because it is a quasi-isomorphism. Transport these isomorphisms through hF and hG.
